description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : cours d'eau BCAE avec bande végétalisée à 10 mètres dans des aires de captages - linéaire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine. Under the 7th National Action Programme (NAP7) "nitrates", rivers under GAEC 2024 must be bordered by a vegetated strip at least 5 metres wide. This measure is, for rivers of measure 8c, increased to at least 10 m in accordance with the 7th Regional Action Programme (PAR7) "nitrates" of Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Coverage: DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine. The portal shows the English title as "New Aquitaine: GAEC watercourse with vegetated strip at 10 metres in catchment areas - linear" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Nouvelle Aquitaine. Its keywords include nouvelle-aquitaine, inspire, mot-cle-gemet, dreal-na, zones-vulnerables. The listing shows 2025-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
